summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for selecting binning threshold rules (Freedman–Diaconis, Scott, Sturges) in data discretization. It does not semantically match any existing skill: the three peer_candidates address data grouping/reduction/indexing (different task_family: data_transformation vs. data_discretization), and the two existing_skills address cache queue sizing and performance monitoring (completely different domains and task families). The candidate has unique objective (compute bin thresholds), method_family (threshold_selection), and supported API (bin.thresholds()). Support evidence from API index confirms the capability is grounded in documented functionality.
